# Dhruv Doshi

## Maintained technical guides

- [Platform architecture: from standards to a usable product](https://doshidhruv.com/guides/platform-architecture/): A practical guide to turning architecture standards into paved roads, reusable contracts, and measurable platform outcomes. Last reviewed 2026-07-28.
- [Observability systems: design the telemetry path before the dashboard](https://doshidhruv.com/guides/observability-systems/): A systems guide to telemetry contracts, collection, routing, storage boundaries, and operational feedback at scale. Last reviewed 2026-07-28.
- [AI governance for software systems: controls that fit delivery](https://doshidhruv.com/guides/ai-governance/): A delivery-focused guide to AI inventories, risk boundaries, evaluation, human oversight, and operational evidence. Last reviewed 2026-07-28.
- [Cloud migration: sequence decisions, not just workloads](https://doshidhruv.com/guides/cloud-migration/): A practical guide to cloud migration boundaries, dependency mapping, landing zones, observability, cutovers, and exit criteria. Last reviewed 2026-07-28.
- [Staff engineering practice: create leverage through clear systems](https://doshidhruv.com/guides/staff-engineering-practice/): A practical guide to technical direction, decision records, cross-team delivery, mentoring, and operational credibility. Last reviewed 2026-07-28.
